mapper.insert: insert into Orders (memberNo, ticketId, ticketTitle, ticketBranch, finalTotalPrice, orderStatus, paymentMethod, orderDate, itemCategory, delay) values (#{memberNo}, #{ticketId}, #{ticketTitle}, #{ticketBranch}, #{finalTotalPrice}, #{orderStatus}, #{paymentMethod}, #{orderDate}, #{itemCategory}, #{delay})

insert into OrderDetail (orderNo, optionId, optionName, totalPricePerOption, quantity, optionStatus, usedDate, barcodeNumber, delay) values
(#{detail.orderNo}, #{detail.optionId}, #{detail.optionName}, #{detail.totalPricePerOption}, #{detail.quantity}, #{detail.optionStatus}, #{detail.usedDate}, #{detail.barcodeNumber}, #{detail.delay})
mapper.select: select * from Orders where memberNo = #{memberNo} and orderStatus = "사용가능"
select * from OrderDetail where orderNo = #{orderNo} and optionStatus = "사용대기"
